R0_PhysicalActivity.title: Physical activity (hours/week)
R0_PhysicalActivity.x-derivation: Baseline total physical activity in MET-hours per week. For each baseline domain, the self-reported hours per week are multiplied by a standard MET value derived as the average of selected activities in the 2024 Adult Compendium of Physical Activities: Strenuous sports/training that made you sweat or breathe hard (R0_SportsSweatHours): MET = 7.2, average of basketball (7.5), football (7.0), tennis singles (8.0), leisurely swimming (6.0), and jogging at self-selected pace (7.5). Work that made you sweat or breathe hard (R0_WorkSweatHours): MET = 5.5, average of manual/unskilled labor, moderate (4.5) and vigorous (6.5) effort. Other activities that made you sweat or breathe hard (R0_OtherSweatHours): MET = 5.5, average of yardwork moderate (4.0), yardwork vigorous (6.0), and chopping/splitting wood vigorous (6.5). Active housework (R0_ActiveHouseworkHours): MET = 3.4, average of heavy cleaning (3.5), multiple household tasks moderate (3.3), and general house cleaning moderate (3.3). Manual labour, gardening, decorating, DIY (R0_ManualLaborHours): MET = 3.9, average of yardwork moderate (4.0), gardening general moderate (3.8), and raking leaves (4.0). Walking (R0_WalkingHours): MET = 3.4, average of walking for pleasure at ~2.5 mph (3.0), ~3.0 mph (3.5), and walking 2.8-3.4 mph at a moderate speed (3.8). Cycling (R0_CyclingHours): MET = 5.0, average of bicycling <10 mph leisure (4.0), self-selected easy pace (4.3), and 10-11.9 mph leisure slow/light effort (6.8). Dancing (R0_DancingHours): MET = 4.8, average of ballet/modern/jazz general (5.0), ballroom fast (5.5), folk dancing moderate (5.0), and contemporary dance general (3.8). Other moderate or light exercise (R0_OtherModerateExerciseHours): MET = 3.8, average of yoga general (2.3), power yoga (4.0), calisthenics light/moderate (3.5), home exercise general (3.8), and health club exercise general (5.5). The derived variable equals the sum of MET x hours contributions across all domains with non-missing hours. If all contributing domains are missing, R0_PhysicalActivity is set to null. Derived from: R0_SportsSweatHours, R0_WorkSweatHours, R0_OtherSweatHours, R0_ActiveHouseworkHours, R0_ManualLaborHours, R0_WalkingHours, R0_CyclingHours, R0_DancingHours, R0_OtherModerateExerciseHours
R0_PhysicalActivity.$comment: Legacy name: PhysMetWorkTot. Upper bound is a plausibility bound the source does not state -- agent-decided.
